name: ttms-eleventy
description: TTMS clean-url migration using Eleventy + Vite with legacy redirect compatibility.

scripts.prebuild: npm run ensure:sourcemaps && npm run sync:legacy-assets && npm run migrate:html && npm run generate:redirects
scripts.postbuild: npm run generate:seo && npm run validate:routes && (cd _site && zip -rq ../_site.zip .)
scripts.dev: npm run ensure:sourcemaps && npm run sync:legacy-assets && npm run migrate:html && npm run generate:redirects && eleventy --serve
